name: vivaldi-links
title: Vivaldi Links
description: Open any link in Vivaldi — a brand new window by default, a tab in the window you are already using with Ctrl+Enter.
author: luan_andrade

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Enter Opens
preferences.description: Which action Enter runs. The other one is always available on the second row, so Ctrl+Enter runs it.

commands.name: open-link
commands.title: Open Link in Vivaldi
commands.subtitle: Vivaldi Links
commands.description: Type or paste a link and open it in Vivaldi. Enter opens a new window, Ctrl+Enter a tab in the window you are using.

commands.name: open-clipboard-link
commands.title: Open Clipboard Link in Vivaldi
commands.subtitle: Vivaldi Links
commands.description: Open whatever link is on the clipboard in a new Vivaldi window, with no intermediate screen.
